headline: RELX Initiates £125M Share Buyback Programme Running Through December
summary: Information and analytics provider RELX has launched a £125 million share repurchase programme scheduled to conclude by December 2, continuing its capital allocation strategy.
why: RELX is a FTSE 100 enterprise providing business analytics, scientific publications, and risk assessment solutions worldwide.

impacts.name: RELX PLC
impacts.why: The £125 million share buyback provides direct demand support for the equity and reduces total share count.
